kaveri_ncd_term_sheet.pdf.text:
Indicative Term Sheet – Project Kaveri
Strictly private and confidential. For discussion purposes only; not an offer.
1. Issuer
Kaveri Precision Components Private Limited (the "Issuer"), a private company incorporated in India with CIN U29253MH2011PTC215478 and PAN AAFCK4821M.
2. Instrument
Senior secured, rated, listed, redeemable non-convertible debentures ("NCDs") of face value ₹1,00,000 each, issued on a private placement basis.1
3. Ticket size
INR 150 crore (Rupees One Hundred and Fifty Crore only), in one or more tranches.
4. Tenor
60 months from the Deemed Date of Allotment, with a bullet redemption at par.
5. Coupon
11.25% per annum, payable quarterly, on an actual/365 day-count basis.2
6. Security
First ranking exclusive charge over the movable fixed assets of the Hosur and Chakan plants, with a minimum security cover of 1.25 times the outstanding amount.
7. Financial covenants
Minimum DSCR of 1.25x and Net debt to EBITDA not exceeding 2.5x, tested semi-annually on the audited or reviewed financial statements.
8. Use of proceeds
Refinancing of existing term loans, capital expenditure on the new machining line and general corporate purposes not exceeding 25% of the issue size.
9. Conditions precedent
Execution of the debenture trust deed, creation of security, credit rating of at least A- and receipt of the board and shareholder resolutions.
10. Governing law and jurisdiction
The NCDs shall be governed by the laws of India. The courts and tribunals at Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction.3
11. Fees
Arranger fee of 0.75% of the issue size, payable on the Deemed Date of Allotment.
1 The NCDs will be listed on the wholesale debt market segment of BSE Limited.
2 Step-up of 0.50% per annum for every notch of rating downgrade below A-.
3 Subject to the arbitration clause in the debenture trust deed.

kaveri_information_memorandum.docx.text:
Information Memorandum – Project Kaveri
Prepared for prospective investors in the proposed NCD issue of Kaveri Precision Components Private Limited.
Company overview
History
Kaveri Precision Components Private Limited (CIN U29253MH2011PTC215478) was incorporated in 2011 and manufactures precision machined components for two-wheeler and tractor OEMs from plants at Chakan and Hosur.
Operations
The Company operates 146 CNC machining centres and employs 1,240 people. Its top five customers contributed 61% of FY24 revenue.
Shareholding
The cap table below is on a fully diluted basis, including the ESOP pool and the Series A compulsorily convertible preference shares.
Shareholding pattern as at 31 March 2024 (fully diluted)
Shareholder Class No. of shares % holding
Raghunathan Family Trust Equity 1,32,00,000 55.00%
Meera Raghunathan Equity 24,00,000 10.00%
Deccan Growth Fund II CCPS Series A 60,00,000 25.00%
ESOP pool Options 12,00,000 5.00%
Others Equity 12,00,000 5.00%
Total 2,40,00,000 100.00%
Financial highlights
In FY24 revenue from operations was ₹412.38 crore and EBITDA was ₹68.15 crore (16.5% margin). Net debt as at 31 March 2024 was ₹96.40 crore.
Proposed transaction
Use of proceeds
The INR 150 crore NCD issue will refinance existing term loans and fund the new machining line at Hosur.

Generate the bake-off corpus (fictional 'Project Kaveri' deal pack) + ground_truth.json.

Every document is rendered from the same element list that produces its ground truth:
elements are ("h", text, level) | ("p", text) | ("t", name, grid) | ("fn", text).
Ground-truth text = headings/paragraphs as-is, tables row by row (non-empty cells joined by
a space), in reading order. Merged cells: text in the first cell of the span, "" elsewhere.
